db_evidence.notes: The correct time window (70380-70440, episodes:3min:000391 / topic_facts around 70380-70410) is reliably surfaced by semantic_search on 'episodes' as the top hit in all 5 rollouts. However, the auto-generated text captions (topic_facts, semantic_triples) at that exact window are unreliable for the specific 4-item 泡酒物 list: topic_facts:00001496 (t=70380) describes a different menu category (蒸馏物/distillate additive slots, 9 items) and topic_facts:00001497 (t=70410) lists yet another wrong set of 泡酒物 items (松罗琼草, 紫纹梅核, 蜂山石髓, 仙官) that also do not match the reference. The correct 4 items (困龙须/瑶池莲子/铜丸/紫纹缃核) are only recoverable via clip_qa visual verification tightly scoped to ~70410-70425. Additionally, a near-duplicate distractor scene exists at 66750-66810 (a different location, 丹灶谷, unrelated to Cuiyun/Pingyun Hall) that also shows base liquor 猴儿酿 with a different ingredient grid, and is easy to confuse with the true clue window via keyword/embedding search on '猴儿酿' or '泡酒物'.

root_causes: Text-layer captions (topic_facts/semantic_triples) near the clue interval describe the wrong menu category (distillate vs. liquor-infusion slots) or list wrong item names entirely, so any rollout that trusted text alone without a tightly-scoped clip_qa got the wrong answer (rollout 3, score 1)

A near-duplicate distractor scene at a different in-game location (66750-66810) shares the same base-liquor name (猴儿酿) and similar 'brewing/更换仙酿' phrasing, causing semantic_search and run_sql window selection to latch onto the wrong interval despite the correct interval having already been surfaced as the top episodes hit (rollout 2, score 2)

Even when the correct window and clip_qa are used, OCR/transliteration of small Chinese UI text is noisy, producing item-name variants (固光须 vs 困龙须, 琥珀莲子 vs 瑶池莲子) that the judge tolerated as correct in one case (rollout 4, score 5) but this is a source of answer variance across otherwise-correct rollouts
what_worked: Successful rollouts (0, 1, 4) all ran run_sql across multiple tables (episodes/topic_facts/semantic_triples/object_states) restricted to the precise 70350-70590 window before invoking clip_qa, rather than answering from text alone

Rollout 0 additionally re-invoked clip_qa a second time with a much tighter time range (70415-70425) specifically to resolve OCR uncertainty from its first broader clip_qa call, which fixed an initially wrong item reading
All correct rollouts used clip_qa as the final arbiter for the exact 泡酒物 item list rather than trusting any single text row, since no text row in the DB contains the correct 4-item list verbatim
transferable_lessons: For fine-grained UI-text entity questions (exact item names in a menu), do not trust topic_facts/semantic_triples text as final evidence even when its time window matches the clue interval -- these auto-captions can describe the wrong sub-menu/category or misread text; always confirm with a tightly time-scoped clip_qa before submitting

When multiple semantic_search/run_sql attempts surface two similarly-worded scenes (same base item name, similar action phrase) at different timestamps, prefer the window that best matches ALL question constraints (here: location name 'Cuiyun/Pingyun Hall' AND result name 'Dragon Paste/龙膏'), not just the one matching a partial keyword like the base liquor name alone

When a clip_qa read is uncertain or partial (e.g., only 2-3 of the expected N items visible), re-invoke clip_qa with a narrower time window and an explicit request to read all N item labels in order, rather than submitting a partial/uncertain list

Distinguish between visually/semantically adjacent menu categories in this game's UI (e.g. 泡酒物 'liquor infusion' vs 蒸馏物 'distillate additive') by name before copying an item list from a text record into the final answer
open_questions: Whether the judge's scoring rubric treats 固光须/琥珀莲子 (rollout 4) as acceptable transliteration variants of 困龙须/瑶池莲子 by design, or whether this is judge leniency that would not generalize to a stricter grader
Whether the underlying auto-caption pipeline systematically confuses 泡酒物 and 蒸馏物 menu categories elsewhere in this game's footage, which would affect other similar brewing/crafting questions
